training_clips: reuse the frozen 10 clips per original training speaker from recording-quality selection
augmentation: singleN: same clean anchor, all second members condition N (50% total); dropN: original mixed schedule with condition N slots replaced by clean, other slots exactly unchanged (about 40% total); clean and mixed controls replayed
initialization: same original final all36 encoder and classifier head; reset optimizer identically; fixed final update, no checkpoint selection
calibration: each model clean JVS validation FAR1% reused for all JVS stress conditions; CV validation FAR1% separately; freeze all models and thresholds before test inference
evaluation: same frozen JVS validation/test 150 queries each, all six conditions with fixed original boundaries; same CV validation/test 900 queries each; clean enrollment; no RMS normalization
scope: predeclared all-five single-condition and all-five leave-one-out comparisons on previously observed development cohorts; no untouched-test claim; no candidate-dependent omission

candidate_gate.description: Exploratory point-estimate screening against clean fine-tuning, both policies: JVS clean FAR increase <=0.001 and FRR increase <=0.01; reverb FRR increase <=0.01; CV FAR increase <=0.001 and FRR increase <=0.01; JVS white-snr20 and white-snr10 EER must both improve. A passing candidate requires fresh evaluation; not an adoption guarantee.
candidate_gate.further_evaluation: Only after this gate: freeze candidate, preprocessing and threshold calibration protocol before any unused cohort processing. No passing arm means no fresh data consumed.
